# Cleaning

```{r, cleaning}
# Read
exp_data <- read_csv("ward_jop_localcandidates_exp_data.csv")

# Clean and rename
exp_data <- rename(exp_data, "duration" = "Duration (in seconds)")
names(exp_data) <- tolower(names(exp_data))
exp_data <- rename(exp_data, resp_race = race, resp_education = education)

# Treatment group: participants who saw the neighborhood prime have a treatment reflection
exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(treatment_group = !is.na(treatment))

# Party including leaners (pid2 asked of independents and others). Sets the primary shown
exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(pid_lean = case_when(
    is.na(pid2) ~ pid1,
    !is.na(pid2) ~ pid2
  ))

# Candidate gender, from the name shown on each profile
MaleNames <- c("James", "Michael", "William", "John", "David")
FemaleNames <- c("Susan", "Jennifer", "Emily", "Olivia", "Barbara")

get_gender <- function(name) {
  # Remove anything in parentheses, then trim whitespace and lowercase
  clean_name <- trimws(tolower(gsub("\\s*\\(.*\\)", "", name)))

  if (clean_name %in% tolower(MaleNames)) {
    return("Male")
  } else if (clean_name %in% tolower(FemaleNames)) {
    return("Female")
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

rounds <- 1:3
for (r in rounds) {
  prof1_col <- paste0("profile1_round", r)
  prof2_col <- paste0("profile2_round", r)

  gender1_col <- paste0("profile1_gender_round", r)
  gender2_col <- paste0("profile2_gender_round", r)

  exp_data[[gender1_col]] <- sapply(exp_data[[prof1_col]], get_gender)
  exp_data[[gender2_col]] <- sapply(exp_data[[prof2_col]], get_gender)
}

# Respondent-level variables, carried onto every profile row
respondent_vars <- exp_data %>%
  select(-starts_with("profile"), -starts_with("chosen_profile")) %>%
  names()

# Reshape one round and task to long format: two rows, one per profile
reshape_round_task <- function(df, round_num, task_suffix) {
  chosen_col <- paste0("chosen_profile_", task_suffix, "_round", round_num)
  prof1_name_col <- paste0("profile1_round", round_num)
  prof2_name_col <- paste0("profile2_round", round_num)

  df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    do({
      respondent_row <- .

      # Chosen profile
      chosen_val <- respondent_row[[chosen_col]]
      prof1_name <- respondent_row[[prof1_name_col]]
      prof2_name <- respondent_row[[prof2_name_col]]

      base_data <- respondent_row[respondent_vars]

      tibble(
        profile = c(1, 2),
        profile_name = c(prof1_name, prof2_name),
        chosen = c(chosen_val == prof1_name, chosen_val == prof2_name),
        education = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_education_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_education_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        race = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_race_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_race_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        gender = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_gender_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_gender_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        family_ties = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_family_ties_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_family_ties_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        residence_length_as_adult = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_residence_length_as_adult_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_residence_length_as_adult_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        birthplace = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_birthplace_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_birthplace_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        residence = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_residence_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_residence_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        political_experience = c(
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile1_political_experience_round", round_num)]],
          respondent_row[[paste0("profile2_political_experience_round", round_num)]]
        ),
        round = round_num,
        task = task_suffix
      ) %>%
        bind_cols(base_data)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# 3 rounds x 2 tasks, so 12 profile rows per respondent
all_long <- map_dfr(1:3, function(r) {
  bind_rows(
    reshape_round_task(exp_data, r, "q1"),
    reshape_round_task(exp_data, r, "q2")
  )
})

# Congressman and Congresswoman combined
all_long <- all_long %>%
  mutate(
    political_experience = case_when(
      political_experience == "Congressman" | political_experience == "Congresswoman" ~ "Congress",
      TRUE ~ political_experience
    )
  )

# Reference levels
all_long <- all_long %>%
  mutate(
    education = factor(education, levels = c("High school diploma", "Bachelor's degree")),
    race = factor(race, levels = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic")),
    family_ties = factor(family_ties, levels = c(
      "No extended family live in the neighborhood",
      "Some extended family live in the neighborhood",
      "Most extended family live in the neighborhood"
    )),
    residence_length_as_adult = factor(residence_length_as_adult, levels = c(
      "Just moved to the neighborhood",
      "Lived in the neighborhood for 5 years",
      "Lived in the neighborhood for 20 years"
    )),
    birthplace = factor(birthplace, levels = c("Not born in the neighborhood", "Born in the neighborhood")),
    residence = factor(residence, levels = c("Rents a house in the neighborhood", "Owns a house in the neighborhood")),
    political_experience = factor(political_experience, levels = c("None", "State legislator", "Congress")),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

all_long <- all_long %>%
  mutate(chosen = as.numeric(chosen))

all_long <- all_long %>%
  mutate(
    pid_lean = factor(pid_lean, levels = c(
      "Neither",
      "Democrat",
      "Republican"
    ))
  )

# Urbanicity from RUCA codes. 99 (not coded) is NA
all_long <- mutate(all_long,
  rural_urban_ruca = case_when(
    ruca1 == 1 | ruca1 == 2 | ruca1 == 3 ~ "City",
    ruca1 == 4 | ruca1 == 5 | ruca1 == 6 ~ "Large town",
    ruca1 == 7 | ruca1 == 8 | ruca1 == 9 ~ "Town",
    ruca1 == 10 ~ "Rural",
  )
)

all_long <- all_long %>%
  mutate(
    rural_urban_simplified = factor(rural_urban_ruca, levels = c(
      "Rural",
      "Town",
      "Large town",
      "City"
    ))
  )
```

# Data and methods

<br />

### Exclusion criteria

```{r, exclusions}
# Bottom decile of reflection length, by condition (124 and 84 characters)
quantile(nchar(all_long$treatment), probs = c(0.10), na.rm = TRUE)
quantile(nchar(all_long$control), probs = c(0.10), na.rm = TRUE)

all_long <- all_long %>%
  mutate(short_text = case_when(
    nchar(treatment) < 124 | nchar(control) < 84 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(short_text = case_when(
    nchar(treatment) < 124 | nchar(control) < 84 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

# Q1 is personal preference, Q2 electability. Models use Q1 unless stated
all_long_q1 <- all_long %>% filter(task == "q1")

# Upper duration limit: three standard deviations above the mean
mean_x <- mean(all_long$duration, na.rm = T)
sd_x <- sd(all_long$duration, na.rm = T)
threshold <- mean_x + 3 * sd_x

# Exclusion criteria
all_long_q1_restricted <- all_long_q1 %>%
  filter(duration >= 60, duration <= threshold, gpt_answer == 0, short_text == 0, q_recaptchascore > 0.4, attention_check == "Strongly disagree")
all_long_restricted <- all_long %>%
  filter(duration >= 60, duration <= threshold, gpt_answer == 0, short_text == 0, q_recaptchascore > 0.4, attention_check == "Strongly disagree")
exp_data_restricted <- exp_data %>%
  filter(duration >= 60, duration <= threshold, gpt_answer == 0, short_text == 0, q_recaptchascore > 0.4, attention_check == "Strongly disagree")

# Model 1 (primary): exclusions, rounds 1-2. Model 2: exclusions, all rounds. Model 3: no exclusions, rounds 1-2. Model 4: no exclusions, all rounds
all_long_q1_restricted_r12 <- all_long_q1_restricted %>% filter(round == 1 | round == 2)
all_long_restricted_r12 <- all_long_restricted %>% filter(round == 1 | round == 2)
all_long_q1_full_r12 <- all_long_q1 %>% filter(round == 1 | round == 2)

# Exclusions by criterion (respondents may fail more than one)
exp_data %>%
  summarise(
    recruited = n(),
    duration_short = sum(duration < 60),
    duration_long = sum(duration > threshold),
    gpt_answer = sum(gpt_answer != 0),
    short_text = sum(short_text == 1),
    recaptcha = sum(q_recaptchascore <= 0.4),
    attention_check = sum(attention_check != "Strongly disagree" | is.na(attention_check)),
    excluded = n() - nrow(exp_data_restricted)
  ) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

### Table A.7: Exclusions

```{r, exclusions table}
# Exclusions by criterion and condition (respondents may fail more than one)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(exp_data$responseid))
exclusions <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(treatment_group) %>%
  summarise(
    completed = n(),
    duration_short = sum(duration < 60),
    duration_long = sum(duration > threshold),
    gpt_answer = sum(gpt_answer != 0),
    short_text = sum(short_text == 1),
    recaptcha = sum(q_recaptchascore <= 0.4),
    attention_check = sum(attention_check != "Strongly disagree" | is.na(attention_check)),
    retained = sum(responseid %in% exp_data_restricted$responseid)
  ) %>%
  mutate(excluded = completed - retained)
exclusions <- bind_rows(exclusions, summarise(exclusions, across(-treatment_group, sum)))
stopifnot(exclusions$completed[3] == nrow(exp_data), exclusions$retained[3] == nrow(exp_data_restricted))
print(exclusions, width = Inf)
```

### Tables A.8 and A.9: Balance

```{r, balance checks}
# Respondent characteristics (Table A.8) and conjoint attributes (Table A.9)
balance_respondent <- c("resp_race", "resp_education", "hh_income", "pid_lean", "age", "resp_gender", "state")
balance_conjoint <- c("family_ties", "residence_length_as_adult", "race", "birthplace", "residence", "political_experience", "education", "gender")
treatment_var <- "treatment_group"

# t-test for numeric variables, chi-square otherwise. Std diff is Cramer's V for categorical variables
balance_check <- function(data, treatment, covariates) {
  results <- list()

  for (var in covariates) {
    if (is.numeric(data[[var]])) {
      # For continuous variables. t is treatment minus control
      treat_vals <- data[data[[treatment]] == TRUE, var, drop = TRUE]
      control_vals <- data[data[[treatment]] == FALSE, var, drop = TRUE]
      test <- t.test(treat_vals, control_vals)

      mean_treat <- mean(treat_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      mean_control <- mean(control_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

      # Calculate standardized difference
      sd_pooled <- sqrt((var(treat_vals, na.rm = TRUE) + var(control_vals, na.rm = TRUE)) / 2)
      std_diff <- (mean_treat - mean_control) / sd_pooled

      # Add to results
      result <- tidy(test)
      result$mean_treat <- mean_treat
      result$mean_control <- mean_control
      result$std_diff <- std_diff

      results[[var]] <- result

    } else {
      # For categorical variables
      tbl <- table(data[[var]], data[[treatment]])
      test <- chisq.test(tbl)

      # Calculate Cramer's V for standardized difference
      n <- sum(tbl)
      cramers_v <- sqrt(test$statistic / (n * (min(nrow(tbl), ncol(tbl)) - 1)))

      # For categorical variables, use the proportion in most common category
      props <- prop.table(tbl, margin = 2)

      # Get modal proportions
      modal_treat <- max(props[,2])
      modal_control <- max(props[,1])

      # Add to results
      result <- tidy(test)
      result$mean_treat <- modal_treat  # Proportion in most common category
      result$mean_control <- modal_control
      result$std_diff <- cramers_v

      results[[var]] <- result
    }
  }

  # Combine all results
  bind_rows(results, .id = "Variable")
}
balance_results <- balance_check(exp_data_restricted, treatment_var, balance_respondent)
balance_results_conjoint <- balance_check(all_long_q1_restricted, treatment_var, balance_conjoint)

# Format the table
balance_table <- balance_results %>%
  select(Variable, mean_treat, mean_control, std_diff, statistic, p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    # Format numeric values - determine type based on variable name
    mean_treat = case_when(
      Variable %in% c("age", "duration") ~ sprintf("%.1f", mean_treat),
      # For categorical variables, show as percentage
      TRUE ~ ifelse(mean_treat < 1, sprintf("%.0f%%", mean_treat*100), sprintf("%.1f", mean_treat))
    ),
    mean_control = case_when(
      Variable %in% c("age", "duration") ~ sprintf("%.1f", mean_control),
      # For categorical variables, show as percentage
      TRUE ~ ifelse(mean_control < 1, sprintf("%.0f%%", mean_control*100), sprintf("%.1f", mean_control))
    ),
    std_diff = sprintf("%.2f", std_diff),
    statistic = sprintf("%.1f", statistic),
    p.value = sprintf("%.2f", p.value)
  )

balance_table
balance_results_conjoint
```

### Manipulation check

```{r, manipulation check}
# Belonging item as a number, 5 = strongly agree. Don't know is NA
likert_code <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "Strongly agree" ~ 5,
    x == "Agree" ~ 4,
    x == "Neither agree nor disagree" ~ 3,
    x == "Disagree" ~ 2,
    x == "Strongly disagree" ~ 1,
    x == "Don't know" ~ NA_real_
  )
}

variable_names <- c("manipulation_check_1")

exp_data_restricted <- exp_data_restricted %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(variable_names), likert_code))

# Condition by response, sample after exclusions. Asked after all three conjoint rounds
contingency_table <- table(exp_data_restricted$treatment_group, exp_data_restricted$manipulation_check_1)
chi_squared_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
print(chi_squared_test)

# Effect size: Cramer's V
cramers_v <- function(chisq_result, n, minDim) {
  sqrt(chisq_result$statistic / (n * (minDim - 1)))
}

n <- sum(contingency_table) # Total number of observations
minDim <- min(nrow(contingency_table), ncol(contingency_table)) # Minimum dimension of table

v <- cramers_v(chi_squared_test, n, minDim)
print(v)
```

### Pilot study

```{r, pilot}
# Pilot, March 2025. Same vignettes, belonging item asked straight after the prime
pilot <- read.csv("ward_jop_pilot_data.csv")

# Pilot codes run 1 = strongly agree to 5 = strongly disagree. Reverse to match the main study, don't know (6) is NA
reverse_code <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 1 ~ 5,
    x == 2 ~ 4,
    x == 3 ~ 3,
    x == 4 ~ 2,
    x == 5 ~ 1,
    x == 6 ~ NA_real_
  )
}

pilot <- pilot %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c("Q5_1")), reverse_code))

# Sample
table(pilot$Group)

# Drop the one participant without an answer, then test condition by response
pilot_complete <- subset(pilot, !is.na(Group) & !is.na(Q5_1))
contingency_table_pilot <- table(pilot_complete$Group, pilot_complete$Q5_1)
chi_squared_test_pilot <- chisq.test(contingency_table_pilot)
print(chi_squared_test_pilot)

# Effect size, compared with the main study's in the text
n_pilot <- sum(contingency_table_pilot) # Total number of observations
minDim_pilot <- min(nrow(contingency_table_pilot), ncol(contingency_table_pilot)) # Minimum dimension of table

v_pilot <- cramers_v(chi_squared_test_pilot, n_pilot, minDim_pilot)
print(v_pilot)
```

### Figure 1 and Table A.10: AMCEs

```{r, AMCEs overall}
# AMCEs: linear probability model of choice on all attributes, SEs clustered on respondent
amce_model_q1 <- lm_robust(
  formula = chosen ~ education + race + family_ties +
    birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + gender + political_experience,
  data = all_long_q1_restricted_r12,
  clusters = responseid
)

texreg(amce_model_q1, single.row = TRUE, include.ci = FALSE)

# Figure 1: AMCEs with reference levels at zero
amce_levels <- tribble(
  ~Attribute, ~term, ~label,
  "Family ties", NA, "No extended family",
  "Family ties", "family_tiesSome extended family live in the neighborhood", "Some extended family",
  "Family ties", "family_tiesMost extended family live in the neighborhood", "Most extended family",
  "Birthplace", NA, "Not born in neighborhood",
  "Birthplace", "birthplaceBorn in the neighborhood", "Born in neighborhood",
  "Homeownership", NA, "Rents",
  "Homeownership", "residenceOwns a house in the neighborhood", "Owns house",
  "Length of residence", NA, "Just moved",
  "Length of residence", "residence_length_as_adultLived in the neighborhood for 5 years", "Lived 5 years",
  "Length of residence", "residence_length_as_adultLived in the neighborhood for 20 years", "Lived 20 years",
  "Political experience", NA, "None",
  "Political experience", "political_experienceState legislator", "State legislator",
  "Political experience", "political_experienceCongress", "Congress",
  "Education", NA, "High school diploma",
  "Education", "educationBachelor's degree", "Bachelor's degree",
  "Race", NA, "White",
  "Race", "raceBlack", "Black",
  "Race", "raceHispanic", "Hispanic",
  "Gender", NA, "Male",
  "Gender", "genderFemale", "Female"
)
stopifnot(all(na.omit(amce_levels$term) %in% tidy(amce_model_q1)$term))

amce_plot_data <- amce_levels %>%
  left_join(tidy(amce_model_q1), by = "term") %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = replace_na(estimate, 0),
    Attribute = factor(Attribute, levels = unique(amce_levels$Attribute)),
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label)))
  )

ggplot(amce_plot_data, aes(x = estimate * 100, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low * 100, xmax = conf.high * 100), height = 0, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggforce::facet_col(vars(Attribute), scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  labs(x = "Change in probability of being chosen (percentage points)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black")
  )

ggsave("amce_overall_q1.pdf", width = 6, height = 7.5, units = "in")
ggsave("amce_overall_q1.png", width = 6, height = 7.5, units = "in", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

### Table A.11: Conditional AMCEs by treatment

```{r, Conditional AMCEs by treatment}
# Same model, estimated separately in each condition
amce_treat_q1 <- lm_robust(
  data = filter(all_long_q1_restricted_r12, treatment_group == TRUE),
  formula = chosen ~ education + race + family_ties + gender +
    birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + political_experience,
  clusters = responseid
)

amce_control_q1 <- lm_robust(
  data = filter(all_long_q1_restricted_r12, treatment_group == FALSE),
  formula = chosen ~ education + race + family_ties + gender +
    birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + political_experience,
  clusters = responseid
)

texreg(list(amce_treat_q1, amce_control_q1), single.row = T, include.ci = FALSE)
```

### Table A.12: Marginal means, full model and by treatment

```{r, MM treatment}
# Marginal means: share of profiles with each level that were chosen. Full sample and by condition
cj_results_overall <- cj(
  data = mm_data,
  formula = chosen ~ education + race + family_ties +
    birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + gender + political_experience,
  id = ~responseid,
  estimate = "mm"
) %>%
  mutate(model = "Full model")

cj_results_treatment <- cj(
  data = filter(mm_data, treatment_group == TRUE),
  formula = chosen ~ education + race + family_ties +
    birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + gender + political_experience,
  id = ~responseid,
  estimate = "mm"
) %>%
  mutate(model = "Treatment")

cj_results_control <- cj(
  data = filter(mm_data, treatment_group == FALSE),
  formula = chosen ~ education + race + family_ties +
    birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + gender + political_experience,
  id = ~responseid,
  estimate = "mm"
) %>%
  mutate(model = "Control")

mm_combined <- bind_rows(cj_results_overall, cj_results_treatment, cj_results_control) %>%
  rename(term = level) %>%
  mutate(
    `Estimate (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", estimate, std.error)
  ) %>%
  select(model, term, `Estimate (SE)`)

# Side-by-side table
table_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
  mm_combined,
  names_from = model,
  values_from = `Estimate (SE)`
)

modelsummary::datasummary_df(
  table_wide,
  title = "Marginal Means by Treatment Group",
  output = "latex"
)
```

### Local candidate and carpetbagger probabilities

```{r, conditional pred prob}
# Logit on the same attributes, for predicted probabilities of named profiles
fit_q1 <- glm(
  chosen ~ education + race + gender + political_experience +
           birthplace + residence + residence_length_as_adult + family_ties,
  data = all_long_q1_restricted_r12,
  family = binomial()
)

# Fully local and fully non-local profiles, otherwise identical
local_profile <- tibble(
  education = "Bachelor's degree",
  race = "White",
  gender = "Female",
```

### Table 2 and Table A.14: Treatment interactions

```{r, interactions by treatment}
# Treatment interacted with every attribute. Each interaction is the change in that attribute's effect under the prime
# Model 1 (primary): exclusions, rounds 1-2
interaction_m1 <- lm_robust(
  formula = chosen ~ treatment_group * (family_ties +
    birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
  ),
  data = all_long_q1_restricted_r12,
  clusters = responseid
)

# Model 2: exclusions, all rounds
interaction_m2 <- lm_robust(
  formula = chosen ~ treatment_group * (family_ties +
    birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
  ),
  data = all_long_q1_restricted,
  clusters = responseid
)

# Model 3: no exclusions, rounds 1-2
interaction_m3 <- lm_robust(
  formula = chosen ~ treatment_group * (family_ties +
    birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
  ),
  data = all_long_q1_full_r12,
  clusters = responseid
)

# Model 4: no exclusions, all rounds
stopifnot(n_distinct(all_long_q1$responseid) == nrow(exp_data))
interaction_m4 <- lm_robust(
  formula = chosen ~ treatment_group * (family_ties +
    birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
  ),
  data = all_long_q1,
  clusters = responseid
)

texreg(list(interaction_m1, interaction_m2, interaction_m3, interaction_m4), single.row = T, include.ci = FALSE, digits = 3)

# Family ties: most minus some extended family, and any family against none (mean of the two interactions)
some_family <- "treatment_groupTRUE:family_tiesSome extended family live in the neighborhood"
most_family <- "treatment_groupTRUE:family_tiesMost extended family live in the neighborhood"
family_contrasts <- function(m) {
  stopifnot(all(c(some_family, most_family) %in% names(coef(m))))
  b <- coef(m)
  V <- vcov(m)
  diff <- b[most_family] - b[some_family]
  diff_se <- sqrt(V[most_family, most_family] + V[some_family, some_family] - 2 * V[most_family, some_family])
  any <- (b[most_family] + b[some_family]) / 2
  any_se <- sqrt(V[most_family, most_family] + V[some_family, some_family] + 2 * V[most_family, some_family]) / 2
  tibble(
    most_minus_some = diff, se_diff = diff_se, p_diff = 2 * pnorm(-abs(diff / diff_se)),
    any_vs_none = any, se_any = any_se, p_any = 2 * pnorm(-abs(any / any_se))
  )
}
map_dfr(list(`Model 1` = interaction_m1, `Model 2` = interaction_m2, `Model 3` = interaction_m3, `Model 4` = interaction_m4), family_contrasts, .id = "model")
```

### Table A.15: Omnibus tests

```{r, omnibus tests}
# Omnibus tests (Leeper, Hobolt and Tilley 2020) as Wald tests, SEs clustered on respondent
# Local interactions, non-local interactions, and all treatment terms
local_attrs <- "family_ties + birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence"
nonlocal_attrs <- "education + race + gender + political_experience"

omnibus_test <- function(data) {
  stopifnot(all(c("chosen", "treatment_group", "responseid") %in% names(data)))
  full <- lm_robust(as.formula(paste("chosen ~ (", local_attrs, "+", nonlocal_attrs, ") * treatment_group")),
    data = data, clusters = responseid
  )
  b <- coef(full)
  V <- vcov(full)
  treat_terms <- grep("treatment_groupTRUE", names(b), value = TRUE)
  interactions <- setdiff(treat_terms, "treatment_groupTRUE")
  local_terms <- interactions[str_detect(interactions, "family_ties|birthplace|residence")]
  nonlocal_terms <- setdiff(interactions, local_terms)
  stopifnot(length(local_terms) == 6, length(nonlocal_terms) == 6, length(treat_terms) == 13)
  wald <- function(coefs, label) {
    k <- length(coefs)
    chisq <- as.numeric(t(b[coefs]) %*% solve(V[coefs, coefs]) %*% b[coefs])
    tibble(terms = label, df = k, chisq = chisq, p.value = pchisq(chisq, k, lower.tail = FALSE))
  }
  bind_rows(
    wald(local_terms, "Local"),
    wald(nonlocal_terms, "Non-local"),
    wald(treat_terms, "All attributes")
  ) %>%
    mutate(n_obs = nobs(full), n_respondents = n_distinct(data$responseid))
}

bind_rows(
  omnibus_test(all_long_q1_restricted_r12) %>% mutate(model = "Model 1 (primary): exclusions, rounds 1-2"),
  omnibus_test(all_long_q1_restricted) %>% mutate(model = "Model 2: exclusions, all rounds"),
  omnibus_test(all_long_q1_full_r12) %>% mutate(model = "Model 3: no exclusions, rounds 1-2"),
  omnibus_test(all_long_q1) %>% mutate(model = "Model 4: no exclusions, all rounds")
)
```

### Table A.19: Treatment interactions by conjoint round

```{r, interactions by round}
# Model 2 (exclusions) estimated separately for each round
interaction_by_round <- map(1:3, function(r) {
  lm_robust(
    formula = chosen ~ treatment_group * (family_ties +
      birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
    ),
    data = filter(all_long_q1_restricted, round == r),
    clusters = responseid
  )
})

texreg(interaction_by_round, custom.model.names = c("Round 1", "Round 2", "Round 3"), single.row = T, include.ci = FALSE)

# Joint Wald test of the six local interactions in each round, and pooled
wald_local <- function(model, pattern = "^treatment_groupTRUE:(family|birth|residence)") {
  terms <- str_subset(names(coef(model)), pattern)
  stopifnot(length(terms) == 6)
  b <- coef(model)[terms]
  w <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(vcov(model)[terms, terms]) %*% b)
  c(chisq = w, df = 6, p = pchisq(w, 6, lower.tail = FALSE))
}
rbind(
  "Round 1" = wald_local(interaction_by_round[[1]]),
  "Round 2" = wald_local(interaction_by_round[[2]]),
  "Round 3" = wald_local(interaction_by_round[[3]]),
  "Rounds 1-2 (Model 1)" = wald_local(interaction_m1),
  "Rounds 1-3 (Model 2)" = wald_local(interaction_m2)
)

# Mean of the six local interactions by round
sapply(interaction_by_round, function(m) mean(coef(m)[str_subset(names(coef(m)), "^treatment_groupTRUE:(family|birth|residence)")]))

# Where to cut: do the local interactions in round 2 differ from round 1, and in round 3 from rounds 1-2?
round_test <- function(data) {
  lm_robust(
    formula = chosen ~ later * treatment_group * (family_ties +
      birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
    ),
    data = data,
    clusters = responseid
  )
}
wald_local(round_test(all_long_q1_restricted %>% filter(round <= 2) %>% mutate(later = round == 2)), "^laterTRUE:treatment_groupTRUE:(family|birth|residence)")
wald_local(round_test(all_long_q1_restricted %>% mutate(later = round == 3)), "^laterTRUE:treatment_groupTRUE:(family|birth|residence)")
```

### Tables A.20 and A.21: Open-text coding

```{r, open text}
# Coded treatment reflections, in the data file
# llm_code: PI place identity, PD place dependence, MX mixed, UNUSABLE (prompt in opentext_coding_prompt.txt)
# negative: 1 if the reflection says people live there despite the area or for lack of alternatives
# human_code, human_negative: hand-coded validation sample, NA otherwise
stopifnot(all(c("llm_code", "negative", "human_code", "human_negative") %in% names(exp_data)))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(exp_data$llm_code) == exp_data$treatment_group))
stopifnot(all(exp_data$llm_code %in% c("PI", "PD", "MX", "UNUSABLE", NA)), all(exp_data$negative %in% c(0, 1, NA)))

# Table A.20: validation against hand-coded sample
validation <- exp_data %>% filter(!is.na(human_code))
stopifnot(all(validation$treatment_group), all(validation$human_code %in% c("PI", "PD", "MX", "UNUSABLE")))
nrow(validation)
sum(validation$responseid %in% exp_data_restricted$responseid)

agreement <- table(
  human = factor(validation$human_code, levels = c("PI", "PD", "MX", "UNUSABLE")),
  llm = factor(validation$llm_code, levels = c("PI", "PD", "MX", "UNUSABLE"))
)
agreement

cohen_kappa <- function(tbl) {
  p_obs <- sum(diag(tbl)) / sum(tbl)
  p_exp <- sum(rowSums(tbl) * colSums(tbl)) / sum(tbl)^2
  c(agreement = p_obs, kappa = (p_obs - p_exp) / (1 - p_exp))
}
cohen_kappa(agreement)

# PI against PD, responses both coders put in PI or PD
cohen_kappa(agreement[c("PI", "PD"), c("PI", "PD")])

# Negative flag
agreement_negative <- table(human = validation$human_negative, llm = validation$negative)
agreement_negative
cohen_kappa(agreement_negative)

# Table A.21: distribution, after exclusions
opentext_restricted <- exp_data_restricted %>% filter(treatment_group)
opentext_restricted %>%
  count(llm_code) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)

# Any place-identity content (PI or MX)
mean(opentext_restricted$llm_code %in% c("PI", "MX")) * 100

# Negative responses
table(opentext_restricted$llm_code, opentext_restricted$negative)
```

### Table A.22: Number of place-identity and place-dependence claims

```{r, open text claims}
# pi_claims, pd_claims: number of distinct PI and PD claims in each treatment reflection (same prompt, follow-up)
stopifnot(all(c("pi_claims", "pd_claims") %in% names(exp_data)))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(exp_data$pi_claims) == exp_data$treatment_group), all(!is.na(exp_data$pd_claims) == exp_data$treatment_group))
stopifnot(all(exp_data$pi_claims >= 0, na.rm = T), all(exp_data$pd_claims >= 0, na.rm = T))

# Consistency with llm_code, after exclusions
opentext_restricted %>%
  group_by(llm_code) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pi_more = mean(pi_claims > pd_claims),
    pd_more = mean(pd_claims > pi_claims),
    pi_claims = mean(pi_claims),
    pd_claims = mean(pd_claims)
  )

# Joint Wald test on the local attribute terms
wald_test <- function(model, pattern, k) {
  terms <- str_subset(names(coef(model)), pattern)
  stopifnot(length(terms) == k)
  b <- coef(model)[terms]
  w <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(vcov(model)[terms, terms]) %*% b)
  c(chisq = w, df = k, p = pchisq(w, k, lower.tail = FALSE))
}

# Attribute effects by number of PI and PD claims, treated respondents only
interaction_claims <- lm_robust(
  formula = chosen ~ (pi_claims + pd_claims) * (family_ties +
    birthplace + residence_length_as_adult + residence + education + race + gender + political_experience
  ),
  data = filter(all_long_q1_restricted_r12, treatment_group),
  clusters = responseid
)

texreg(interaction_claims, single.row = T, include.ci = FALSE)
wald_test(interaction_claims, "^pi_claims:(family|birth|residence)", 6)
wald_test(interaction_claims, "^pd_claims:(family|birth|residence)", 6)
```
